title: Tennessee county to pay $1 million to veteran Tasered by deputy in 2022
summary_full: Knox County, Tennessee, has agreed to pay $1 million to Brian Eugene Hux, a 64-year-old disabled Air Force veteran who suffered a fractured skull and brain bleed after being Tasered by a deputy in 2022. The settlement follows a federal appeals court ruling that denied the deputy qualified immunity.
